turns.doctor_question: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi. Well, I came in because I've been dealing with some really awful, unwanted thoughts recently. I'm an artist, and I was working on a memorial piece for my aunt... and I just kept getting these thoughts that I was going to dishonor her somehow. 

It was like, if I made one wrong photo placement or chose the wrong color, it meant I didn't love her enough. I usually get normal creative doubts with my work, but I couldn't just brush these off like I usually do. It really started to get to me, so I figured I should talk to someone about it.
